description: This Java source file defines the MapContext class, which provides a combined view over a collection of maps organized in a deque. It supports operations like push, pop, and addToBottom, and implements the Map interface with additional features for layered map management.

classes.name: MapContext
classes.description: A class that provides a layered map view over a deque of maps, allowing for stack-like operations and layered key-value access.

methods.name: getContexts
methods.description: Returns the deque of maps representing the contexts.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes a new empty map onto the top of the context stack.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes an existing map onto the top of the context stack.

methods.name: addToBottom
methods.description: Adds an existing map to the bottom of the context stack.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the top map from the stack if more than one map exists.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the total number of unique keys across all maps.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if all maps in the context are empty.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if any map in the context contains the specified key.

methods.name: containsValue
methods.description: Checks if any map in the context contains the specified value.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with the key from the first map containing it.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a localized value for the given name and locale, if supported.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Puts a key-value pair into the top map of the context.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key from the top map of the context.

methods.name: putAll
methods.description: Puts all entries from a given map into the top map of the context.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the top map of the context.

methods.name: keySet
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of all keys across all maps.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable collection of all values across all maps.

methods.name: entrySet
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of all entries across all maps.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the layered map structure.
